events: ordinary phases and steps begin in fixed order
every active player passes an empty-stack priority window
a no-priority step completes its turn-based actions
mana empties before the next step begins
represented beginning-of-boundary triggers wait for priority
unsupported skip schedule is rejected before turn mutation
timing: the ordinary turn contains beginning, precombat main, combat, postcombat main, and ending in order
an empty-stack priority step ends only after every active player passes in succession
ordinary untap and cleanup boundaries complete without an ordinary priority window
mana empties synchronously before the next step begins
dynamic duration expiry, phase or step insertion, and skip scheduling remain incomplete
choices: priority passes are chosen sequentially in turn order
simultaneous extra-turn APNAP ordering and arbitrary skip choices remain blocked
hidden_information: turn-structure transitions reveal no hidden card identity
private actions inside component steps remain governed by their contracts
apnap: ordinary priority follows active-player then nonactive-player turn order
simultaneous multi-player extra-turn creation remains blocked
layers: complete duration-effect expiry and continuous-effect interaction remain blocked
replacement_effects: generic phase, step, and turn skips are replacement effects and remain blocked
a pre-populated unsupported skip schedule is rejected rather than silently ignored
copy: copy status does not alter the ordinary fixed turn table
control_change: turn control does not alter the ordinary phase order
zone_change: zone changes inside a phase or step are delegated to the relevant component rule
source_leaves: source-dependent mana-retention and duration effects are not yet universally represented

until-step, until-phase, end-of-combat, and end-of-turn duration expiry

atomic transition with no interstitial game event
rulings: Time Warp — 2022-12-08 — Multiple extra turns are taken in reverse resolution order.
Sphinx of the Second Sun — 2020-11-10 — Multiple phases added at the same point occur most-recently-created first.
Obeka, Splitter of Seconds — 2024-04-12 — Additional upkeep steps create beginning phases whose untap and draw steps are skipped.
Fatespinner — 2004-12-01 — Every instance of the chosen step or phase is skipped, including instances added later.
Omnath, Locus of Mana — 2010-03-01 — Retained green mana keeps its restrictions across later steps, phases, and turns.

implementation.component: TURN_STEPS, CommanderEngine turn/step scheduler, priority passes, mana clearing, extra-turn queue, skip guard, and exact replay

known_blockers: generic effects expiring at the beginning or end of an arbitrary step or phase are not represented
end-of-combat duration expiry is not implemented as a generic duration boundary
mana-retention effects and their source-leaves behavior are not compiled generically
complete beginning-of-phase and beginning-of-step trigger production remains incomplete
simultaneous extra turns are not collected and inserted in APNAP order
extra phase and extra step schedules are not represented
step-after-phase construction and controller-relative suppression are not represented
generic skip replacement ordering is not implemented
complete component-phase semantics remain bounded by their partial contracts
